preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and len(stdin) > 0 and len(stdin) <= 10000
preconditions.description: The input is a non-empty string with length at most 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ,.!? ' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input contains only lowercase Latin letters, spaces, and the specified punctuation marks (dot, comma, exclamation mark, question mark).
The text begins and ends with a Latin letter.
There is at least one word between any two punctuation marks, implying no two punctuation marks are adjacent without a word in between.

postconditions.expression: not any(stdout[i:i+2] == ' ,' or stdout[i:i+2] == ' .' or stdout[i:i+2] == ' !' or stdout[i:i+2] == ' ?' for i in range(len(stdout)-1))
postconditions.description: There are no spaces immediately before any punctuation mark.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout[i+1] == ' ' and i+1 < len(stdout)) for i, c in enumerate(stdout) if c in ',.!?')
postconditions.description: There is exactly one space immediately after each punctuation mark, unless the punctuation mark is the last character (which is impossible per P3, but the condition holds for the space requirement).

postconditions.expression: not any(stdout[i:i+2] == '  ' for i in range(len(stdout)-1))
postconditions.description: There are no consecutive spaces in the output.
The output does not end with a space.
The output does not start with a space.

postconditions.expression: len([c for c in stdout if c.isalpha()]) == len([c for c in stdin if c.isalpha()])
postconditions.description: The set of words (sequences of letters) in the output is identical to the input, preserving order and content.

postconditions.expression: len([c for c in stdout if c in ',.!?']) == len([c for c in stdin if c in ',.!?'])
postconditions.description: The set of punctuation marks in the output is identical to the input, preserving order and content.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ,.!? ' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output contains only lowercase Latin letters, spaces, and the specified punctuation marks.
